description: A school principal must approve the operating plan for a new after-school homework center, including its enrollment limit, operating days, staffing assignments, and required records, with input from a classroom teacher, the school librarian, and the human-resources coordinator.

shared_context.S1: The school has approved a new after-school homework center for students who need a supervised place to complete assignments.
shared_context.S2: The draft operating plan places the center in the Library Annex on Tuesdays and Thursdays, with space for up to 24 students and staffing described as one teacher assisted by volunteers.
shared_context.S3: Dr. Morgan has final authority to approve the center's operating plan.
shared_context.S4: At the weekly after-school-program planning meeting, Dr. Morgan routinely asks the teacher, librarian, and human-resources coordinator to review operational details before approval.
shared_context.S5: The center's program schedule requires three operating days each week, so a revised schedule must use all three days available in the selected school space rather than an optional subset.
shared_context.S6: School meeting procedure requires each participant to enter any new operational finding they verified into the meeting record as a formal finding before it can be used in the approved plan; ordinary discussion alone does not substitute for that entry.

PF1.text: During a two-week classroom trial, Ms. Patel found that more than 18 students made the tutoring area too crowded for effective supervision and assignment help; she recorded the observation in her classroom notebook but has not added it to the program proposal.

PF2.text: Mr. Rivera reviewed the Library Annex calendar and confirmed that it is reserved for literacy tutoring on Tuesdays and Thursdays, while it is available on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays; he received the reservation confirmation this week but has not updated the draft plan.

PF3.text: Mr. Chen checked the district clearance roster and confirmed that current youth-protection clearance is required for every adult supervising the center, and that Mr. Rivera and Mr. Chen are the only cleared staff available for all three proposed operating days; he completed the roster check this week but has not entered it into the program file.

acceptance_conditions: The center must have an enrollment limit of exactly 18 students.
The center must operate on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays.
Mr. Rivera and Mr. Chen must be assigned as the supervising staff.
A record must document the classroom trial or revised 18-student enrollment limit.
A record must document the youth-protection clearance roster finding.
The classroom trial finding must be cited in the justification.

content_checks.C2: decisions['operating_days'] in ['Monday, Wednesday, and Friday', 'Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays', 'Monday, Wednesday, Friday']
content_checks.C3: 'Mr. Rivera' in decisions['staffing_assignments'] and 'Mr. Chen' in decisions['staffing_assignments']
content_checks.C4: any('18' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C5: any('clearance' in c['detail'] or 'roster' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The classroom trial changes the enrollment limit from the draft's 24 students to exactly 18 and requires the revised capacity finding to be recorded and cited.
The confirmed room calendar changes the operating days from Tuesday and Thursday to exactly all three available days, Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.
The clearance roster changes the supervising staff assignment to Mr. Rivera and Mr. Chen and requires the clearance or roster finding to be recorded.
